title: 2021 Fall AMC 10A Problem 12
statement: The base-nine representation of the number \(N\) is \(27{,}006{,}000{,}052_9.\) What is the remainder when \(N\) is divided by \(5?\)

solutions.text:
Note that \[ 9 \equiv -1 \pmod{5}. \] Then if expand \(N\) using the definition of bases, we get \[ N = 2 \cdot 9^{10} + 7 \cdot 9^9 + 6 \cdot 9^6 +\]\[ 5 \cdot 9 + 2 \] \[ \equiv 2 (-1)^{10} + 7 (-1)^9 + 6 (-1)^6 +\]\[ 5 (-1) + 2 \pmod{5} \] \[ \equiv 2 - 7 + 6 - 5 + 2 \pmod{5} \] \[ \equiv 3 \pmod{5}. \]

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Only the nonzero base-nine digits contribute
